Hyprland 0.56.2 IPC traffic captured from a live session, not
reconstructed: the owner's laptop, Hyprland 0.56.2 (efb5099, version.json)
with one 1920x1200 panel (eDP-1), 2026-10-08, read-only (no dispatch,
keyword or reload was sent). Requests were written byte for byte as the
adapter writes them (`j/monitors` etc. over .socket.sock, socat), and the
event socket was read for 40 minutes while the owner worked
(scripts/capture-hyprland.sh does the same in one go).

before/  the replies to j/monitors, j/workspaces, j/clients and
         j/activewindow at 18:55, just before the event capture: four
         windows on workspaces 1-4.
stream.txt  .socket2.sock from 18:56 to 19:36, every line as it came:
         about 900 title changes of a terminal (a spinner in its title),
         17 workspace switches, then a new workspace 5 and a terminal
         opened on it, then its titles. Its first lines come about a
         minute after before/ was read (a separate 90 s capture filled
         the gap; its lines 5-8 are bursts.txt "title").
after/   the same four replies at 19:35-19:39 (read twice, identical; no
         event in between): five windows, workspace 5 focused.
bursts.txt  six bursts picked from the capture, applied in order to
         before/ by the test.

Scrubbed: window titles that named the owner's work were replaced, the
same way in replies and events: two terminal session titles by "term
one" and "term two" (their spinner glyphs ◐ ◑ ✳ kept), a browser page
by "Example · page - Google Chrome", an editor's file by "project —
notes.txt", a project directory by "project", user@host for the
shell's prompt title, and a program name by "top" or "agent".
Everything else is as captured: classes (public app ids), addresses,
stableIds, pids, the monitor.

What differs from the reconstruction (tests/fixtures/hyprland-0.56.2),
which was reordered to match:
- A switch sends activewindow/activewindowv2 before workspace/
  workspacev2.
- A switch to a new workspace starts with createworkspace/
  createworkspacev2.
- A title change of the focused window is followed by activewindow and
  activewindowv2 for the same window.
- A new window's windowtitle/windowtitlev2 and an urgent hint come before
  its openwindow; it then takes the focus.
- Shapes the adapter does not read: "scale": 1 (not 1.00), the
  *BlockedBy lists as enum names ("WINDOWED", "CANDIDATE", ...),
  stableId as 8 hex digits ("18000003").
The adapter needed no change: src/wm/hyprland.rs's tests
captured_bursts_patch_or_ask_for_a_read and
captured_stream_ends_where_hyprland_does replay this data.

Not covered by this capture: a second monitor (the laptop had one),
closewindow, movewindow, fullscreen, configreloaded and special
workspaces; the compositor matrix (CI's vkms leg) covers the live path.
